recognize_zh: 這是 G-banding 核型圖：第 7 號只剩一條（圈起），第 9 號其中一條長臂末端外觀不同、第 22 號其中一條明顯變短（Philadelphia chromosome），合計 45 條，對應 -7 合併 t(9;22)。
features: GTG-banded karyogram arranged by ISCN order with circled abnormalities
Single chromosome 7 (monosomy 7), giving a total count of 45
Chromosome 9 pair circled: one homolog with altered distal 9q banding, consistent with der(9)t(9;22)
Chromosome 22 pair circled: one homolog visibly shortened, consistent with the Philadelphia chromosome der(22)t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
Two chromosomes in the X position with the Y position empty/faded, although the text karyotype reads XY
Moderate band resolution; fine breakpoints cannot be independently confirmed at this image resolution
describe_en: G-banded karyogram from an unstimulated bone marrow aspirate culture shows 45 chromosomes. There is a single chromosome 7 (monosomy 7) and a balanced reciprocal translocation between 9q34 and 22q11.2, with a visibly shortened derivative chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome) and an altered derivative chromosome 9. The image appears to show two X chromosomes and no Y, which fits the stated female patient; the written karyotype 45,XY,-7,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)[20] likely contains a sex-chromosome typographical error. In a CD10-positive B-lymphoblastic leukemia, these findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with BCR::ABL1 and additional monosomy 7, both adverse features; note that a modal number of 45 is near-diploid and should not be confused with true hypodiploid ALL (<44 chromosomes).

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: Carries the same t(9;22), so separation relies on clinical history, absence of a preceding chronic phase, basophilia/splenomegaly, and BCR::ABL1 transcript type (p210 favors CML, p190 favors de novo Ph+ ALL).
Shares a kinase-activated gene expression profile but lacks a cytogenetically visible Philadelphia chromosome and BCR::ABL1 fusion by FISH/RT-PCR.
Defined by fewer than 44 chromosomes with multiple whole-chromosome losses, whereas this karyogram has 45 chromosomes with a single monosomy plus a structural translocation.
Involves a third chromosome in the rearrangement, which would be seen as an additional abnormal homolog and confirmed by BCR::ABL1 FISH.
